item.title: Meowdoro 0.1.29
item.description: • Choose when you count as away from the Mac. Settings → iPhone → Away from this Mac after: 1, 2, 3, 5 or 10 minutes without the keyboard or mouse (5 by default). After that, your iPhone purrs at the end of a session instead of the Mac. A locked or sleeping Mac still counts at once (Meowdoro for iPhone is in testing).
